text: Yet once more the fitting-out miscarried, and the patron was wroth beyond measure.
gloss_source: The deploy failed again and the client is furious.

text: The patron writ back in great contentment, professing that her long-sought want was at last fulfilled.
gloss_source: The user wrote back: exactly what I needed.

text: Upon the third day of the week the forenoon assembly is removed from the half-hour of nine to the three-quarter mark.
gloss_source: Standup moved 9:30 to 9:45 Tuesdays.

text: The whole volume wherein three months of remembrance were laid up was utterly undone.
gloss_source: Entire recovery volume lost; three months of journal entries gone.

text: The vessel set down twenty minutes before her hour, and my burden was first upon the turning-wheel.
gloss_source: Flight early, bag first on the belt.

text: The instrument, by its standing order, answers `not found' for writings that are struck from the record.
gloss_source: API returns 404 for deleted documents by design.

text: My tutor declared my design the plainest and most cleanly reasoned she had met this twelvemonth.
gloss_source: Mentor praised my design doc.

text: The showing brake down plain before a full forty patrons, and none could raise it up again.
gloss_source: Demo crashed before forty investors; unrecoverable.

text: O'er the morning cup with a companion of old we discoursed three hours, yet it passed like a breath.
gloss_source: Coffee with an old friend; three hours like minutes.

text: The reckoning for the third month was discharged upon the twenty-eighth day thereof.
gloss_source: March invoice paid on the 28th.

text: Scarce one hour before I was to mount the stage, word came by letter that my address was recalled.
gloss_source: Talk cancelled an hour before, by email.

text: After two days spent hunting one perverse knot in the clockwork, the assemblage stands hale once more.
gloss_source: Build green again after chasing the race condition.

text: Minutes of the assembly: the four articles were treated; the next sitting falls upon the fifth day.
gloss_source: Meeting notes: items 1-4; next sync Thursday.

text: My speaking-glass slipped from my hand into the harbour, and every likeness of the voyage went down with it.
gloss_source: Phone in the harbour; every photo underwater.

text: This day the apprentice laid her first stone in our common work, and the masters found no fault in it.
gloss_source: Intern's first patch passed review untouched.

text: The quarter's account sets down revenue of four millions and a fifth part, exceeding last year's by the twelfth.
gloss_source: Quarterly report: revenue 4.2M, +8% YoY.

text: The surgeon's work upon my brother prospered beyond hope, and swift mending is foretold.
gloss_source: Brother's surgery went perfectly.

text: The lord of the house means to sell it, and two months are granted me to quit it.
gloss_source: Landlord selling; two months to move.

text: Sunlight lay upon the sill while the trials ran their course, and nothing burned.
gloss_source: Sunlight through the window while the tests ran.

text: The twelfth ordering of the schema adds a column of keeping-days, its default thirty.
gloss_source: Schema v12 adds retention_days=30.

text: The customer threatened the law, and set his learned man in witness of the reply.
gloss_source: Customer threatened legal action, CC'd counsel.

text: The fault is found: one ensign set backwards. The mending is but two lines.
gloss_source: Found the bug: one inverted flag, two-line fix.

text: The company's midday order stands writ: three flat noodles, one green curry, one fried rice.
gloss_source: Lunch order noted.

text: All that I had wrought this week must be wrought anew, for the ordinance upstream has shifted.
gloss_source: Everything this week must be redone; spec changed.

text: The children set love-apples in the garden beds today, laughing in the soil.
gloss_source: Children planted tomatoes today.

text: The safe-keeping copy was made whole at twelve minutes past the third hour, forty-one thousand measures, without blemish.
gloss_source: Backup completed 03:12, 41 GB, no errors.

text: The stewards have proclaimed the great weeding of the rolls; my whole company is struck off by Friday.
gloss_source: Layoffs confirmed; my whole team gone by Friday.

text: The endowment is granted outright: provision for two years, with no condition laid upon it.
gloss_source: Grant approved: two years, no conditions.

text: For every day a borrowed book outruns its term, the library claims a quarter-dollar.
gloss_source: Library 0.25/day late fee.
